headline: Power Backup for Tom Green County Homes
summary: Homes in Tom Green County face a long outage about once every 10 years based on 8 years of records since 2018. In February 2021, 49% of homes in the county lost power. The longest-waiting tenth faced about 70 hours. In May 2019, 48% of homes in the county lost power. The longest-waiting tenth faced about 13 hours. One Core lasts about 15 hours in August. One Core lasts about 38 hours in November. Two Cores last about 23 hours in August. Two Cores cover 96% of past 12-hour-plus outage hours for gas heat and a larger footprint homes. Base confirms sizing at install.
